title: 【风格】
content:
【风格】
真实手机第一视角恶作剧短视频，现代地铁站实拍质感。
全片唯一主角是女主。黑色皮鞋只是开场触发剧情的临时道具，不能成为持续追踪的主体。

【Style】
Realistic first-person prank short video shot on a mobile phone, with the authentic feel of a modern subway station.  
The sole protagonist of the entire film is the female lead. The black leather shoes are just a temporary prop to trigger the plot at the beginning and should not become the main focus of continuous tracking.
